name: Proton Mail Bridge
description: Proton Mail Bridge runs locally on your computer and provides a local SMTP/IMAP server, allowing any email client to connect to your Proton Mail account.

notes.text: **Important:** After installation, run `protonmail-setup` inside the container to add your account
Requires a **paid ProtonMail account** (Mail Plus, Unlimited, etc.)
IMAP: Port 11143 | SMTP: Port 11025 (accessible from other containers/devices)
Run `info` in the CLI to display the generated credentials for email clients
